campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council's September 15, 2026, agenda included a proposed change to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, an update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27, and a budget adjustment related to a replacement project. Residents interested in these items can check the city's published agenda for full details.
keyTopics: Proposed modification to Council Policy Section 14, the theater use policy, effective September 16th
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for resurfacing work
Resolution approving the annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Resolution authorizing a budget adjustment to fund a replacement project

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council agenda for September 16, 2026, included routine items like meeting minutes and check registers, along with two appeals of Planning Commission decisions—one for a home and ADU on 6th Street, and another for a three-lot subdivision on Oak Place. The agenda also listed a discussion on law enforcement service options ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission approval conditions for a single-family residence and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Law enforcement service options discussion ahead of September 19 and 30 town halls
Final map approvals for two-lot subdivisions at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council agenda for September 22, 2026, included routine items like approving prior meeting minutes and a wastewater treatment plant agreement, along with an urgency ordinance on detention and custodial facilities. The agenda also listed a VTA Board appointment, several city commission appointments, and an update to the city's legal services contract.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on applications for detention or custodial facilities and custodial-processing facilities
Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant Basic Agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Councilmember Jonathan Weinberg's appointment to an additional two-year term on the VTA Board representing north counties
Appointments to the Complete Streets Commission, Environmental Commission, and Planning Commission
Amendment No. 1 to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating the monthly retainer to $21,500 for up to 70 hours plus a $385 hourly rate

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: This Los Gatos Town Council agenda for September 15, 2026, includes routine approvals of prior meeting minutes and a monthly financial report, along with several contract and agreement actions. These include amendments related to a professional services agreement, HVAC maintenance, and new professional services agreements the Town Manager would be authorized to execute.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Town Council meeting and closed session
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026 (with a correction noted)
Second amendment to an existing professional services agreement
First amendment to a Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) services agreement
New professional services agreements for the Town Manager to execute

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 30, 2026
san-jose.summary: This is a procedural San José City Council committee agenda covering routine business: finalizing the October 6, 2026 Council meeting agenda, reviewing a public record, and a work plan update. It also lists several special event approvals, a travel request, and three policy items on surveillance technology and council transparency practices.
keyTopics: Review and finalization of the October 6, 2026 Council agenda, including adding items and possible time-certain assignments

Special event approvals: a Councilmember Mulcahy-sponsored 'Conversations for Good 2026' event, a District 9 farewell celebration, and retroactive approval of a Golden State Valkyries flag raising event
Proposed policy on Council transparency and private non-disclosure agreements
Two related items on internal controls and data access safeguards for Automated License Plate Readers
Joint Special Meeting agenda with the San José/Santa Clara Treatment Plant Advisory Committee

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee — September 29, 2026
mountain-view.summary: This Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee agenda covers the city's draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan and the 2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory. The meeting includes a public comment period and time for committee and staff discussion.
keyTopics: Draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan
2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 29, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council's September 29, 2026, agenda includes several contract and budget items, a proposed five-year Homelessness Response Plan, and recognition of Filipino American History Month, Hindu American Heritage Month, and Domestic Violence Awareness Month. Other listed items cover technology upgrades, a water facility relocation agreement tied to the US 101 Express Lanes project, and positions on upcoming state and local ballot measures.
keyTopics: Adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, with a community outreach update
Contract awards for City Hall video conferencing/traffic management upgrades, UPS system upgrades, and a 10-year computerized maintenance management system
Reimbursement agreement with VTA for relocating city water facilities for the US 101 Express Lanes project, plus a related $300,000 budget modification
Side letter with the Public Safety Officers Association adding special assignment pay for a new Community Crime Reduction Team
Council positions on state and local ballot measures for the November 3, 2026 election

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — October 5, 2026
cupertino.summary: The agenda for this Cupertino City Council meeting lists a closed-session item to conduct the City Manager's performance evaluation, followed by a public report on that closed session. The rest of the agenda consists of standard legal and procedural notices rather than policy items for public discussion.
keyTopics: Closed session: City Manager performance evaluation
Open session report following the closed session

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council's agenda for this meeting includes a public hearing on a proposed housing development at 451-475 El Camino Real, which would involve annexing the land into the city, rezoning it, and approving plans for 408 new homes. The agenda also lists closed-session discussions on existing and anticipated legal matters, including a case involving the city's power utility and the state's Department of Water Resources.
keyTopics: Public hearing on prezoning, land use designation, annexation, and a subdivision map to allow 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under CEQA
Closed-session discussion on existing litigation: City of Santa Clara (Silicon Valley Power) and Northern California Power Agency vs. California Department of Water Resources
Closed-session discussion on anticipated litigation involving one potential case

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council agenda for this meeting lists a review of federal community development grant funding, a presentation on the city's red light camera program, and an update on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The agenda also includes financial items tied to winding down the former Redevelopment Agency, including a bond refunding resolution.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency
Resolution for the sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Climate Action and Sustainability Committee — October 2, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Climate Action and Sustainability Committee's agenda for October 2, 2026, includes an update on long-duration resiliency for the electric system, along with routine staff and committee member comments. The agenda notes this item has been determined not to be a project under CEQA.
keyTopics: Update on Electric System Long Duration Resiliency, including a staff presentation
CEQA determination for the resiliency item: Not a Project
